# Lexora

Lexora is a source-faithful workbook practice system. Its public portfolio demo
uses a curated synthetic workbook and validated exercise analysis. Interactive
mode provides deterministic checks where canonical answers exist; Classic mode
keeps the original page available. Ask Lexora offers bounded contextual help—
Explain, Translate, Hint, and questions—when the current exercise or selection
is reliable. True open responses can receive AI-assisted feedback, which is not
source-authoritative grading. Public assistance is protected by verification and
session quotas, and unreliable source context fails closed.

- [Project overview](https://github.com/darroyo083/Lexora)
- [Interactive public demo](/demo)
